structuredContent.name: ewpa/create-code-snippet
structuredContent.label: Create Code Snippet
structuredContent.description: Creates a PHP code snippet via the Code Snippets plugin. The snippet is always saved as inactive — it must be activated manually from wp-admin › Snippets. Validates PHP syntax, blocks dangerous functions, and fires an audit action hook after saving.

code.description: PHP code to save. Do not include the opening <?php tag.

description.description: Optional description of what the snippet does.

scope.description: Where the snippet runs: global (frontend + admin), admin, or frontend. Defaults to global.

tags.description: Optional list of tags for organisation.

active.description: Always false. Activate manually from wp-admin.
